customerState.description: Status of a workstation. Possible States: 1) Unknown - The trxState of the workstation is not known. 2) Transparent - The workstation state handler should not change the transactionState field in the workstationState table. 3) Starting - The workstation is starting up. 4) Operator - The workstation is in operator mode (SOP active). 5) Open consumer - The workstation is open for consumers. 6) Close consumer -  The workstation is not open for consumers, however startup was complete. 7) Offline - The workstation timer detected a timeout (heart beat). 8) Open consumer with indication - The workstation is open for consumers. But due to missing or defect devices the functionality may be restricted. 9) GreenIT - The workstation is in GreenIT mode.

installat.description: Place where workstation has been installed

type.description: Type of a workstation. Possible Types: 1) ATM 2) SP 3) AST / SST 4) Recycler 5) Deposit

cashLevel.description: Cash level, a color indicator for cash status. Possible Levels: 1) UNKNOWN - Cash level is not available. 2) GREEN - All cash devices have a good threshold state. 3) YELLOW - Some devices have a critical threshold state. 4) RED - At least one of the devices has a bad threshold state.
